lxc_99187ab8cbd98e6b.text: Recent AI work shows three ways to handle stronger models: control who can use them, add safety systems, and study what happens inside them.

lxc_47ab2ce75345db83.text: Mythos 5.1, GPT-6 Astra, and J-space help us understand these different approaches.

lxc_6d1cff3fd7d2cf3d.text: We can use three questions: What is the source, what changed, and what was the result?

lxc_470aad0c352a143b.text: The source may be a company or a research team.

lxc_dffe6bfd19bce957.text: The change may be a stronger model, different safety rules, or a new research tool.

lxc_c660878860f4a10c.text: The result affects how people can use or study the system.

lxc_0cd77acb43e9993a.text: In July 2026, Anthropic published research about J-space inside Claude models.

lxc_1309f22b31663be2.text: Around 1 September, it introduced Mythos 5.1 for trusted specialist work.

lxc_ea1d9ac94d369eb4.text: Around 3 September, OpenAI released GPT-6 Astra to a limited set of customers.

lxc_d34ece8437b79265.text: These developments are connected, but they are not the same kind of thing.

lxc_43eba3c53abdade3.text: J-space is a research finding, not a product.

lxc_ae098fd56dc6d24e.text: Anthropic introduced two versions of the same underlying model: Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1.

lxc_79718997d3f7ce4f.text: They have the same learned core, but different safeguards.

lxc_162eed871e206896.text: Fable 5.1 became generally available for coding, knowledge work, and long problem-solving.

lxc_3b27509342dfec02.text: It can help find weaknesses in software code, but it blocks help with developing ways to attack those weaknesses.

lxc_f22927219f9107d4.text: Mythos 5.1 has more permissive safeguards for approved cyber and life-science research.

lxc_9eae03a9368e53b3.text: For this reason, it is invite-only.

lxc_0ef78df07fbf70de.text: Vetted people and groups can receive access through the Cyber Verification Program or the Life Sciences Verification Program.

lxc_7d8264254ea67606.text: Mythos 5.1 also powers Claude Security, a tool that scans collections of code, finds possible security problems, and suggests repairs for a person to review.

lxc_cee5dbf40010f5e9.text: Here, stronger access depends on trust and purpose.

lxc_dd1f64ade846a603.text: OpenAI released GPT-6 Astra to a limited group around 3 September 2026.

lxc_850e972064d4d395.text: The model can control computer systems and complete tasks for users, such as filling spreadsheets or building websites.

lxc_562d075dd8dc1507.text: OpenAI described it as a strong step for computer use, coding, science, and professional work.

lxc_8cc14ff6e1606e66.text: Its cyber ability also created serious risk.

lxc_c88301199cffcce9.text: Under OpenAI’s Preparedness Framework, GPT-6 Astra was the first OpenAI model to reach the Critical cybersecurity capability level.

lxc_9294291fe8118372.text: With suitable tools and access, it can find previously unknown security weaknesses and develop ways to use them against many well-protected systems without a person directing every step.

lxc_ec947b534e4ad279.text: OpenAI therefore added stronger safeguards and monitoring.

lxc_4187318446784120.text: Access began with cyber defenders in the Daybreak program, while wider ChatGPT and API access was planned for the following days.

lxc_a6858898b08f9ba1.text: It is a small set of internal neural patterns that researchers found inside language models such as Claude.

lxc_e2d2567e72d5ee09.text: They used the J-lens, short for Jacobian lens, to find these patterns.

lxc_156b657c0596d7fa.text: Each pattern connects to a word that is on the model’s “mind,” even when the model does not write that word.

lxc_5288f3706acd8645.text: Researchers call this a global workspace because important concepts appear in a shared internal channel.

lxc_ba68aba1644030f5.text: It works silently and is different from a written chain of thought, which is an explanation shown in words.

lxc_e580b5b505eb463f.text: By studying J-space, researchers can sometimes see hidden concepts.

lxc_354df5b9a24dc4d5.text: This may help them notice when a model is going off track or possibly cheating on a safety test.

lxc_8dde89835d0325fa.text: The J-lens does not open every thought, but it offers a new way to inspect some internal activity.

lxc_92062a7f2d7452d9.text: These examples show that “better” can mean several things.

lxc_7cba0a855b25e445.text: A model may become more capable, but people also need ways to manage its risks.

lxc_f7170aad01b03a15.text: Anthropic used different safeguards and trusted-access programs for Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1.

lxc_a4b268dfbbfadead.text: OpenAI used its Preparedness Framework, monitoring, and staged access for GPT-6 Astra.

lxc_89e3bd227e2c5488.text: These systems control what a model may do and who can use its strongest abilities.

lxc_27307eb80dad922a.text: J-space supports a different goal: understanding internal activity.

lxc_d62f33347bf6e1a3.text: It may help researchers see silent concepts and detect troubling behavior during a test.

lxc_0d79e0dba7149b79.text: So we can reuse our lens.
